module: Submodule of the third-party Copas library: lock (mutex) between Copas coroutines. A coroutine that requests an already-held lock yields until it is released or the timeout expires. By default the lock is re-entrant and the timeout is 10 s. The module returns the table lock.
usage:
local lock = require("libs/copas/copas/lock").new(5)
local ok, err = lock:get()
-- critical section
lock:release()
notes: get returns the wait time on success, or nil, error, wait time with the error among "timeout", "destroyed", "lock is not re-entrant".
release returns nil + "cannot release a lock not owned" if the current coroutine is not the owner.

__index.desc: Metatable of the lock objects (lock itself).

not_reentrant.desc: If true, a coroutine cannot re-acquire a lock it already holds

get.desc: Acquires the lock; yields while another coroutine holds it. With timeout = 0, returns immediately without yielding.

timeout.desc: Timeout in seconds, takes precedence over the one from new

returns.desc: Wait time on success, otherwise nil
Error: timeout, destroyed or lock is not re-entrant

release.desc: Releases the lock held by the current coroutine.
